verdict.rationale: Cake documents an official MCP connection for Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client. The agent can query shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes from the live cap table, read-only, which gives it programmatic cap-table data to reconcile against a data room. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific MCP tools or a full structured cap-table export, any data-room integration or reconciliation workflow, a public REST/OpenAPI alternative (probes 404'd), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
